```{r}
library(nososim)
devtools::load_all()
library(tidyverse)
```

`nososim` simulates outbreaks with changing populations and contacts.

## Landscape

Create nested locations with a capacity value.

```{r}
# Patient capacity at the room level.
patient_landscape <- make_landscape(list(
  Geneva = list(
    ICU = list(a = 2, b = 3),
    General = list(a = 1, b = 4, c = 2)
  ),
  Gallen = list(
    ICU = list(a = 3, b = 5),
    General = list(a = 2, b = 4, c = 1)
  )
))

# Staff capacity at the ward level.
staff_landscape <- make_landscape(list(
  Geneva = list(ICU = 2, General = 3),
  Gallen = list(ICU = 3, General = 4)
))

staff_landscape
```

## Populations

`make_population()` defines rules; `make_outbreak()` runs them each day.
Use `arrivals` to choose how many people enter available places, `attributes` to assign their initial attributes, and `update` to apply rules to current occupants at the end of each day.
All rules use `(data, t)`. For `arrivals`, `data` is the landscape with today's free places in `available`; `capacity` remains the total capacity.

### Patients
Here, we define a bed filling probability for each ward and assign attributes such as age, length of stay, and a transmission parameter `tau`. We extend the length of stay once when a patient becomes infected. The occupied bed therefore remains unavailable for new admissions.

```{r}
patient_landscape <- patient_landscape |>
  mutate(
    filling_prob = case_when(
      level_1 == "Geneva" & level_2 == "ICU" ~ 0.9,
      level_1 == "Geneva" & level_2 == "General" ~ 0.7,
      level_1 == "Gallen" & level_2 == "ICU" ~ 0.8,
      level_1 == "Gallen" & level_2 == "General" ~ 0.5
    )
  )

patients <- make_population(
  patient_landscape,
  arrivals = function(data, t) {
    rbinom(nrow(data), size = data$available, prob = data$filling_prob)
  },
  attributes = function(data, t) {
    data |>
      mutate(
        role = "patient",
        age = sample(18:90, n(), replace = TRUE),
        stay = case_when(
          level_2 == "ICU" ~ sample(3:7, n(), replace = TRUE),
          level_2 == "General" ~ sample(5:10, n(), replace = TRUE)
        ),
        tau = 0.2
      )
  },
  update = function(data, t) {
    data |>
      mutate(
        stay = stay + if_else(date_infection == .env$t, 3L, 0L, missing = 0L)
      )
  }
)

patients
```

## Staff

Schedule five one-day shifts per person each week. Reuse `labels` across shifts.

```{r}
dates <- as.Date("2026-01-01") + 0:29

set.seed(123)
staff_schedule <- staff_landscape |>
  uncount(capacity) |>
  mutate(labels = paste0("S_", row_number())) |>
  crossing(week = unique(as.Date(cut(dates, "week")))) |>
  reframe(
    t = week + sample(0:6, 5),
    .by = c(level_1, level_2, labels, week)
  ) |>
  select(-week)

staff_on_duty <- function(t) {
  staff_schedule |>
    filter(t == .env$t) |>
    select(level_1, level_2, labels)
}

staff <- make_population(
  staff_landscape,
  arrivals = function(data, t) {
    data |>
      left_join(
        count(staff_on_duty(t), level_1, level_2),
        by = c("level_1", "level_2")
      ) |>
      mutate(n = coalesce(n, 0L)) |>
      pull(n)
  },
  attributes = function(data, t) {
    data |>
      distinct() |>
      left_join(staff_on_duty(t), by = c("level_1", "level_2")) |>
      mutate(role = "staff", stay = 1L, tau = 0.2)
  }
)
staff
```

## Contacts

`get_contacts()` defaults to matching all location levels. This rule allows
patient contacts within rooms and staff contacts throughout their hospital.
Matrix rows are sources, columns are recipients.

```{r}
contact_rule <- function(i, j) {
  same_hospital <- i$level_1 == j$level_1
  same_ward <- i$level_2 == j$level_2
  same_room <- i$level_3 == j$level_3
  either_staff <- i$role == "staff" | j$role == "staff"

  same_hospital & (either_staff | (same_ward & same_room))
}

weights <- list(
  level_2 = matrix(
    c(2, 1, 3, 1),
    nrow = 2,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(c("ICU", "General"), c("ICU", "General"))
  ),
  role = matrix(
    c(1, 2, 1, 1),
    nrow = 2,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(c("patient", "staff"), c("patient", "staff"))
  )
)
```

Weights multiply allowed contacts. General staff to an ICU patient has weight `3 * 1 = 3`; the reverse has weight `1 * 2 = 2`.

## Simulate

A named list keeps patient and staff capacities separate. `imported()` returns
susceptible labels to infect; `character()` introduces none.

```{r}
set.seed(123)
debugonce(make_outbreak)
outbreak <- make_outbreak(
  list(patients = patients, staff = staff),
  dates = dates,
  w = c(0, 0.5, 0.3, 0.2),
  imported = function(data, t) {
    if (t == dates[1]) {
      return(head(data$labels, 1))
    }

    if (t == dates[10]) {
      staff_ids <- data$labels[data$role == "staff"]
      return(sample(staff_ids, size = min(1L, length(staff_ids))))
    }

    character()
  },
  contacts = function(data, t) {
    get_contacts(data, by = contact_rule, weights = weights)
  }
)

outbreak$infections
```


## Results

Count secondary infections per person and transmissions between groups.

```{r}
offspring(outbreak)
count_edges(outbreak, by = c("role", "level_2"))
```

Plot occupancy: one row per capacity unit; grey marks vacancies.

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
autoplot(outbreak)

autoplot(outbreak$population, aes(colour = population)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

autoplot(outbreak$population, aes(colour = labels, fill = labels)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```



Plot staff attendance by person.

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
outbreak$population |>
  filter(population == "staff") |>
  ggplot(aes(t, labels, colour = labels)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = t + 1, yend = labels), linewidth = 2) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(level_1, level_2),
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Staff") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

Compare contact weights for the same day's occupants.

```{r contact-comparison, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
present <- outbreak$population |>
  filter(t == dates[1]) |>
  arrange(level_1, level_2, role, labels)

contact_matrices <- list(
  unweighted = NULL,
  role_weighted = weights["role"],
  location_weighted = weights["level_2"],
  all_weighted = weights
) |>
  purrr::map(function(w) get_contacts(present, by = contact_rule, weights = w))

contact_matrices |>
  purrr::imap_dfr(function(values, label) {
    as.data.frame(as.table(values)) |>
      setNames(c("source", "recipient", "intensity")) |>
      mutate(matrix = factor(label, levels = names(contact_matrices)))
  }) |>
  ggplot(aes(recipient, source, fill = intensity)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~matrix, ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = present$labels) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(present$labels)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2166AC", name = "Intensity") +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = "Recipient", y = "Source") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
